verdict.rationale: Canva has no headless mode for the product itself. Its Connect APIs (REST with an OpenAPI description for generating client SDKs) and the MCP server let you drive designs, autofill Brand Templates, bulk-create, resize and export programmatically, which covers API-driven automation. The official CLI is only for building Canva apps, not running Canva in CI, and private integrations are gated to Enterprise plans, with some MCP tools limited to Pro and above. Missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline usage, non-interactive service-account auth for unattended runs, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation, and ungated availability across plans.
